.. change::
    :tags: usecase, orm
    :tickets: 6084

    Added support for specifying string attribute or column names for the
    :paramref:`_orm.Mapper.version_id_col` parameter, resolving to the
    underlying mapped column property similarly to how
    :paramref:`_orm.Mapper.polymorphic_on` functions. This allows specifying
    ``version_id_col`` by name in Declarative mappings and dataclass-mapped
    models without requiring a direct reference to the ``Column`` object.
